BillHeading.BriefDescription: Relating to regulatory and financial mechanisms and means to promote the retirement of coal-fired electric generation facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to regulatory and financial mechanisms and means to promote the retirement of coal-fired electric generation facilities.

BillSectionHeader.P: This act shall be known as the "Washington state coal generation retirement program."
